statement: Manage sheet sets stored as DST files, where sheets are layouts from many drawings organized into subsets, with sheet views, model views, resource drawing locations, and publish, transmit and archive of the set.
superiority: Cloud-neutral sheet sets stored as text.

acceptance.sketch: New sheet set from template with 3 subsets and 6 sheets; sheet numbers autonumber; open sheet from manager opens its layout.

notes: Verified against help page "About Sheet Sets". Corrected: SHEETSET only opens the Sheet Set Manager; it does not create sets (NEWSHEETSET does). Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-EF38E77D-1938-40EC-ACBE-2CC715AEC6E0 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9751A902-27DC-4BCD-8D3D-585478B213DD | prior app hint: cand2 app registers SheetSetNew, SheetSetOpen; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide a Create Sheet Set wizard that builds a new sheet set from an example set or from existing drawing folders, with name, description, storage location and optional subset structure mirroring folders.

acceptance.sketch: Create from existing drawings imports layouts as sheets; sheet set data file DST stored in folder.

notes: Verified against help page "NEWSHEETSET (Command)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F39C5BFC-07F4-4798-A59A-58D2CCD9AE5D | prior app hint: cand2 app registers SheetSetNew; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide a Sheet Set Manager palette with Sheet List, Sheet Views and Model Views tabs whose shortcut menus offer publish, rename and renumber, archive, eTransmit and insert sheet list table.

acceptance.sketch: Rename sheet updates title block field and drawing file name.

notes: Verified against help page "Sheet List Tab (Sheet Set Manager)". Corrected: SHEETSETHIDE only closes the palette and SHEETSET opens it; the palette itself is the Sheet Set Manager. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9751A902-27DC-4BCD-8D3D-585478B213DD ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5D092A7D-AC59-42A6-8BDE-08ADEF6F2670 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers SheetSetOpen; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Support sheet set, subset and sheet properties (including project number, name, phase, milestone and user-defined custom properties) that title blocks can display as sheet set fields.

acceptance.sketch: Change sheet title: title block field in layout updates after regen; custom property "Client" appears in fields.

notes: Verified against help page "Sheet Set Properties Dialog Box". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B5F63864-9B80-469E-B6B9-AA8EC117AD46 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1B6DD22B-10D1-44ED-BAA2-E6D79FE52327 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Field; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Place label blocks and callout blocks from the Sheet Views tab, using placeholder fields in preset attributes so view title and sheet number fill in from the referenced view and sheet.

source.ref: About Sheet Label Blocks and Callout Blocks

acceptance.sketch: View label shows view number and sheet; renumbering sheets updates callouts.

notes: Verified against help page "About Sheet Label Blocks and Callout Blocks". Corrected: No auto-numbering is described; values come from placeholder fields tied to view and sheet data. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-DA868354-801C-43E1-AA31-9C14B51F6D9C ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-BFC36AD5-2136-45C0-BFA5-81328C2BBDC3 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Insert a sheet list table for the sheet set with a chosen table style, configurable columns, optional subset headers and a later edit-settings dialog.

source.ref: Insert Sheet List Table Dialog Box

acceptance.sketch: Table lists 6 sheets; add a sheet then Update Table adds a row.

notes: Verified against help page "Insert Sheet List Table Dialog Box". Corrected: Help does not state the table is field-driven or has an update command; those parts were dropped. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D86D0B53-A79F-4847-8226-7A801D308C6C ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1B3204E2-A259-4200-BAAD-41A845766044 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers SheetSetOpen; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Publish a sheet set or saved sheet selection to DWF, DWFx, PDF or plotter, transmit it, and archive it to a folder as a package.

source.ref: About Publishing, Transmitting, and Archiving Sheet Sets

acceptance.sketch: Publish sheet set creates a multi-sheet PDF in sheet order; archive zip contains all files.

notes: Verified against help page "About Publishing, Transmitting, and Archiving Sheet Sets". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1484D4DE-BE0C-4FF6-BDA1-6F020DA3A177 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers SheetSetPlot; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Allow a page setup overrides file (DWT) so publishing can apply one page setup to every sheet instead of each drawing own page setup.

source.ref: About Page Setups and the Sheet Creation Template

acceptance.sketch: Override A3 PDF applied regardless of layout setup; unchanged files.

notes: Verified against help page "About Page Setups and the Sheet Creation Template". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5FF4D109-B454-4695-97FE-4F644F424E4D | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: List resource drawing folders and their named model views and let the user place a view on a sheet, which attaches the drawing as an xref, creates a layout viewport and records a sheet view.

acceptance.sketch: Drag model view creates a viewport with view and scale.

notes: Verified against help page "Model Views Tab (Sheet Set Manager)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-BFC36AD5-2136-45C0-BFA5-81328C2BBDC3 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Let the user rename and renumber each sheet, optionally renaming the layout and drawing file to the sheet title and prefixing them with the sheet number, and step through sheets in turn.

source.ref: Rename and Renumber Sheet Dialog Box

acceptance.sketch: Renumber starting at A-101 step 1 yields A-101, A-102.

notes: Verified against help page "Rename and Renumber Sheet Dialog Box". Corrected: Subset-based auto-numbering is not described in help. | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: Store per-sheet revision number, revision date, issue purpose and category, plus custom properties, so they can be shown in sheet set fields.

acceptance.sketch: Issue date field updates for selected sheets.

notes: Verified against help page "AcSmSheet (SSO)". Corrected: Properties are documented in the Sheet Set Object API, not in a user-guide topic; use as a field source is inferred from the sheet property mechanism. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-3B0D3681-07BB-4B51-98CE-EB3C996771EB | prior app hint: cand2 app registers RevisionTable; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Lock the sheet set data file automatically and briefly while any user changes it, show lock state and per-sheet status (available, locked, missing) to teammates, and refresh status on demand.

source.ref: About Using Sheet Sets in a Networked Environment

acceptance.sketch: Lock icon displays when sheet is open by another user.

notes: Verified against help page "About Using Sheet Sets in a Networked Environment". Corrected: Locking is automatic with a lock icon, not user-set flags; the ENABLEDSTLOCK variable is deprecated. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B1ED6559-D4D7-469B-A3FC-AE9123E0506B | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.
